title: VoiceChat-TTS: A Low-Latency Continuous Speech Synthesis Model for Interactive Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.13831v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spoken dialogue is a natural form of human--computer interaction, yet most speech language models remain limited to turn-based operation and lack real-time adaptability, such as user barge-in. Recent duplex speech-to-speech and speech-to-text models reduce latency by replacing multi-stage pipelines, but often compromise speech quality because accurate ASR, interruption handling, and high-fidelity synthesis must be optimized jointly. We propose VoiceChat-TTS, a low-latency, continuous, and streamable text-to-speech model for interactive agents. VoiceChat-TTS is driven directly by LLM text-token streams, supports explicit interruption via control tokens, and produces silence when no textual input is available. The model enables always-on, responsive speech generation while preserving modularity and high speech quality, and it supports mid-utterance interruptions without resetting the KV cache.

translated_title: VoiceChat-TTS：一种面向交互式智能体的低延迟连续语音合成模型
translated_abstract: 口语对话是人机交互的一种自然形式，但大多数语音语言模型仍局限于轮流操作，缺乏实时适应性，例如用户插话。近期的双工语音到语音和语音到文本模型通过替换多阶段流水线来减少延迟，但往往以牺牲语音质量为代价，因为准确的自动语音识别、中断处理和高保真合成需要联合优化。我们提出VoiceChat-TTS，一种用于交互式智能体的低延迟、连续、可流式文本到语音模型。VoiceChat-TTS直接由LLM文本令牌流驱动，支持通过控制令牌显式中断，并在无文本输入时产生静音。该模型支持常开、响应式语音生成，同时保持模块化和高语音质量，并支持在不清除KV缓存的情况下进行话语中途中断。
tldr: 本文提出VoiceChat-TTS，一种由LLM文本令牌流直接驱动的低延迟连续语音合成模型，通过控制令牌支持显式插话中断，无需重置KV缓存，在保持模块化和高语音质量的同时实现常开响应式语音生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VoiceChat-TTS, a low-latency continuous speech synthesis model driven directly by LLM text-token streams, supporting explicit barge-in via control tokens without resetting the KV cache, enabling always-on responsive speech generation while preserving modularity and high speech quality.
